string-array.name: voice_greeting_en
string-array.item: Hello! I am Gullak, your savings friend. Tell me, what are you dreaming of saving for?
Hi there! I am Gullak, and I am so glad you are here. What would you like to save for?

string-array.name: voice_greeting_hinglish
string-array.item: Namaste! Main Gullak. Bataiye, kis cheez ke liye paise jodne hain?
Namaste! Aaj kis cheez ke liye bachat shuru karein?

string-array.name: voice_greeting_hi
string-array.item: नमस्ते! मैं गुल्लक हूँ, आपकी बचत की साथी। बताइए, आज किस सपने के लिए पैसे जोड़ने हैं?
नमस्ते जी! मैं गुल्लक हूँ। आपसे बात करके अच्छा लगा। बताइए, किस चीज़ के लिए बचत शुरू करें?

string-array.name: voice_again_en
string-array.item: Sure. What is the next one for?

string-array.name: voice_again_hinglish
string-array.item: Zaroor. Agli gullak kis cheez ke liye?

string-array.name: voice_again_hi
string-array.item: ज़रूर। अगली गुल्लक किस चीज़ के लिए?

string-array.name: voice_moment_en
string-array.item: One moment.
Okay, let me see.

string-array.name: voice_moment_hinglish
string-array.item: Ek second.
Achha, dekhte hain.

string-array.name: voice_moment_hi
string-array.item: एक सेकंड।
अच्छा, देखते हैं।

string-array.name: voice_not_heard_en
string-array.item: Sorry, I did not hear anything. Could you say that again?

string-array.name: voice_not_heard_hinglish
string-array.item: Maaf kijiye, kuch sunai nahi diya. Ek baar phir boliye?

string-array.name: voice_not_heard_hi
string-array.item: माफ़ कीजिए, कुछ सुनाई नहीं दिया। एक बार फिर बोलिए?

string-array.name: voice_not_understood_en
string-array.item: Sorry, I could not follow that. What are you saving for, how much, and by when?

string-array.name: voice_not_understood_hinglish
string-array.item: Maaf kijiye, samajh nahi aaya. Kis cheez ke liye, kitne paise, aur kab tak?

string-array.name: voice_not_understood_hi
string-array.item: माफ़ कीजिए, समझ नहीं आया। किस चीज़ के लिए, कितने पैसे, और कब तक?

string-array.name: voice_which_en
string-array.item: Which one suits you: daily, weekly or monthly?

string-array.name: voice_which_hinglish
string-array.item: Kaunsa theek rahega: roz, hafte, ya mahine?

string-array.name: voice_which_hi
string-array.item: कौन सा ठीक रहेगा: रोज़, हफ़्ते, या महीने?

string-array.name: voice_yes_or_no_en
string-array.item: Shall I start it? Just say yes or no.

string-array.name: voice_yes_or_no_hinglish
string-array.item: Shuru kar doon? Bas haan ya nahi boliye.

string-array.name: voice_yes_or_no_hi
string-array.item: शुरू कर दूँ? बस हाँ या नहीं बोलिए।

string-array.name: voice_change_en
string-array.item: No problem. What should I change?

string-array.name: voice_change_hinglish
string-array.item: Koi baat nahi. Kya badalna hai?

string-array.name: voice_change_hi
string-array.item: कोई बात नहीं। क्या बदलना है?

string-array.name: voice_ask_name_en
string-array.item: What are you saving for?

string-array.name: voice_ask_name_hinglish
string-array.item: Kis cheez ke liye bachana hai?

string-array.name: voice_ask_name_hi
string-array.item: किस चीज़ के लिए बचाना है?

string-array.name: voice_ask_amount_en
string-array.item: How much will you need?

string-array.name: voice_ask_amount_hinglish
string-array.item: Kitne paise chahiye honge?

string-array.name: voice_ask_amount_hi
string-array.item: कितने पैसे चाहिए होंगे?

string-array.name: voice_ask_date_en
string-array.item: And by when do you need it?

string-array.name: voice_ask_date_hinglish
string-array.item: Aur kab tak chahiye?

string-array.name: voice_ask_date_hi
string-array.item: और कब तक चाहिए?

string-array.name: voice_amount_range_en
string-array.item: Gullak can plan from 500 rupees to 50 lakh rupees. What amount should I take?

string-array.name: voice_amount_range_hinglish
string-array.item: Gullak 500 rupaye se 50 lakh rupaye tak ka plan bana sakti hai. Kitna rakhein?

string-array.name: voice_amount_range_hi
string-array.item: गुल्लक 500 रुपये से 50 लाख रुपये तक की योजना बना सकती है। कितना रखें?

string-array.name: voice_date_range_en
string-array.item: That date will not work. Please tell me a date after today, within 10 years.

string-array.name: voice_date_range_hinglish
string-array.item: Yeh tareekh nahi chalegi. Aaj ke baad aur 10 saal ke andar ki tareekh bataiye.

string-array.name: voice_date_range_hi
string-array.item: यह तारीख़ नहीं चलेगी। आज के बाद और 10 साल के अंदर की तारीख़ बताइए।

string-array.name: voice_readback_en
string-array.item: Okay, %1$s, %2$s, by %3$s. Is that right?
So that is %1$s, %2$s by %3$s. Did I get that right?

string-array.name: voice_readback_hinglish
string-array.item: Achha, toh %1$s ke liye %2$s, %3$s tak. Sahi hai?
Theek hai, %1$s, %2$s, %3$s tak. Yahi na?

string-array.name: voice_readback_hi
string-array.item: अच्छा, तो %1$s के लिए %2$s, %3$s तक। सही है?

string-array.name: voice_daily_en
string-array.item: %1$s a day

string-array.name: voice_weekly_en
string-array.item: %1$s a week

string-array.name: voice_monthly_en
string-array.item: %1$s a month

string-array.name: voice_daily_hinglish
string-array.item: roz %1$s

string-array.name: voice_weekly_hinglish
string-array.item: har hafte %1$s

string-array.name: voice_monthly_hinglish
string-array.item: har mahine %1$s

string-array.name: voice_weekly_hi
string-array.item: हर हफ़्ते %1$s

string-array.name: voice_monthly_hi
string-array.item: हर महीने %1$s

string-array.name: voice_or_en
string-array.item: , or

string-array.name: voice_or_hinglish
string-array.item: , ya

string-array.name: voice_plan_en
string-array.item: So for %1$s, you could save %2$s. Which feels easiest?
For %1$s, you could put away %2$s. Which one works for you?

string-array.name: voice_plan_hinglish
string-array.item: %1$s ke liye aap %2$s bacha sakte hain. Aapko kaunsa aasan lagega?

string-array.name: voice_plan_hi
string-array.item: तो %1$s के लिए, आप %2$s बचा सकते हैं। आपको कौन सा आसान लगेगा?
%1$s के लिए तीन तरीके हैं: %2$s। बताइए, कौन सा ठीक रहेगा?

string-array.name: voice_too_close_en
string-array.item: That date is very close, under a week away. Could we take a later date?

string-array.name: voice_too_close_hinglish
string-array.item: Yeh tareekh bahut paas hai, ek hafte se bhi kam. Thodi aage ki tareekh le lein?

string-array.name: voice_too_close_hi
string-array.item: यह तारीख़ बहुत पास है, एक हफ़्ते से भी कम। थोड़ी आगे की तारीख़ ले लें?

string-array.name: voice_autopay_en
string-array.item: Shall I set up AutoPay from your %1$s account, %2$s, starting %3$s? This is a demo, so no real money moves.

string-array.name: voice_autopay_hinglish
string-array.item: Aapke %1$s khate se %2$s ka AutoPay, %3$s se shuru kar doon? Yeh demo hai, asli paisa nahi katega.

string-array.name: voice_autopay_hi
string-array.item: आपके %1$s खाते से %2$s का AutoPay, %3$s से शुरू कर दूँ? यह डेमो है, असली पैसा नहीं कटेगा।

string-array.name: voice_started_en
string-array.item: Done, congratulations! Your %1$s Gullak has started. The first payment goes on %2$s. Anything else?

string-array.name: voice_started_hinglish
string-array.item: Ho gaya! %1$s ki gullak shuru ho gayi. Pehli kist %2$s ko. Aur kuch?

string-array.name: voice_started_hi
string-array.item: हो गया, बधाई हो! %1$s की गुल्लक शुरू हो गई। पहली क़िस्त %2$s को जाएगी। और कुछ?
बहुत बढ़िया! %1$s की गुल्लक शुरू हो गई। पहली क़िस्त %2$s को। और कुछ करना है?

string-array.name: voice_failed_en
string-array.item: Sorry, I could not start it just now. Shall I try again?

string-array.name: voice_failed_hinglish
string-array.item: Maaf kijiye, abhi shuru nahi ho paya. Phir se koshish karoon?

string-array.name: voice_failed_hi
string-array.item: माफ़ कीजिए, अभी शुरू नहीं हो पाया। फिर से कोशिश करूँ?

string-array.name: voice_bye_en
string-array.item: All right. Take care, and happy saving!

string-array.name: voice_bye_hinglish
string-array.item: Theek hai. Bachat mubarak ho!

string-array.name: voice_bye_hi
string-array.item: ठीक है जी। अपना ख़याल रखिए, बचत मुबारक हो!
धन्यवाद! जब मन करे, फिर बात करेंगे।

string-array.name: voice_greeting_progress_en
string-array.item: Hello again! Your %1$s Gullak already has %2$s in it, well done! What shall we save for next?

string-array.name: voice_greeting_progress_hinglish
string-array.item: Namaste! Aapki %1$s gullak mein %2$s jud chuke hain, bahut badhiya! Ab kis cheez ke liye bachat karein?

string-array.name: voice_greeting_progress_hi
string-array.item: नमस्ते जी! आपकी %1$s गुल्लक में %2$s जुड़ चुके हैं, बहुत बढ़िया! अब किस चीज़ के लिए बचत करें?

string-array.name: voice_else_en
string-array.item: Is there anything else?

string-array.name: voice_else_hinglish
string-array.item: Aur kuch?

string-array.name: voice_else_hi
string-array.item: और कुछ?
